title: Distance Between Points Calculator
description: Compute the Euclidean distance between two points in 2D or 3D with the full working shown.
howto: Press Calculate to see the distance and the step-by-step working.

faqs.a: The Pythagorean theorem extended: d = √(Δx² + Δy²) in 2D, plus Δz² in 3D.
It avoids the square root — useful in code and comparisons where only relative distances matter.
Yes, differences are squared so the sign of each coordinate doesn’t matter.
